explanation: Tests follow the nSig rule change from P < 0.01 to FDR < 0.05: bundleWriter.test.ts imports countFdrSignificant and NSIG_FDR_THRESHOLD and expects deSummary counts of finite FDR < 0.05 (a null FDR is not significant), intakeStudies.test.ts expects one significant fixture row instead of two, and qcTables.test.ts pins the 'Sig (FDR<0.05)' heading to NSIG_FDR_THRESHOLD.
